title: RoadRunner Scenario Reader
text: 从 RoadRunner 场景读取所选主题，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Topic Category} 指定主题类别；{Actor Type} 指定场景中的 actor 类型、{Action Type} 指定动作类型 Path、{Sensor View} 指定从场景真值派生的传感器数据 Target、{Event Type} 指定事件类型 User-Defined、{Topic} 指定 actor 数据，或通过传感器视图捕获的车道边界数据 Actor、{Filter} 指定筛选条件 Self、{Additional Relationship} 指定与筛选后的实体的关系、{Sensor ID} 指定传感器的唯一索引、{Sample Time} 指定仿真的采样时间 positive real、{Event Name} 指定事件名称 string，按实例取值。

ports.name: Message
ports.summary: 来自场景的状态信息 Simulink message

params.name: Topic Category
params.values: 主题类别 Actor (default) | Action | Sensor | Event

params.name: Actor Type
params.values: 场景中的 actor 类型 All Types (default) | Vehicle | Traffic Signal | Traffic Signal Controller

params.name: Action Type
params.values: 动作类型 Path Following (default) | Change Parameter | Lane Change | Lateral Offset | Longitudinal Distance | Speed Change | User Defined

params.name: Sensor View
params.values: 从场景真值派生的传感器数据 Target Poses (default) | Target Poses For Host | Lane Boundaries | Target Poses And Lane Boundaries

params.name: Topic
params.values: actor 数据，或通过传感器视图捕获的车道边界数据 Actor Specifications | Actor Pose | Actor Pose (Driving Scenario compatible) | Actor Lane Location | Vehicle Specifications |...

params.name: Filter
params.values: 筛选条件 Self (default) | None | Actor ID (provided by input)

params.name: Additional Relationship
params.values: 与筛选后的实体的关系 None (default) | Parent | Children

params.name: Sensor ID
params.values: 传感器的唯一索引 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Sample Time
params.values: 仿真的采样时间 positive real scalar
